ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 4

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 3

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 36

17. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

19. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

20. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 72

21. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 1

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

23. Solve for x: x + 8 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 13
   C. 5
   D. 6

24. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
